To set a special ringtone for someone, the app needs permission to update that contact. It only changes the ringtone on your phone — nothing is uploaded or shared.
Trim a sound and save it first, then you can assign it to a friend.
Contacts permission is needed only to set a friend\'s ringtone. You can turn it on in Settings.
